title: Fullness of bounded-below etale realization
statement: For every commutative ring B and scheme T, the functor from bounded-below derived etale sheaves of ULift B-modules to the full pro-etale derived category, obtained by inclusion followed by derived comparison inverse image, is full. Use the module sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules].

proof.text: Apply the already proved bijective_comparisonUpperStar_mapDerivedCategory_map to the underlying bounded-below source and target; take its surjectivity clause and wrap the lifted morphism in the full subcategory. This corollary uses the generic comparison injective-acyclicity theorem recorded by the cited node; its source proof still contains sorry, so this fullness bridge is conditional on that existing hole.
